common.tagline: Find and list retail spaces with AI
common.description: Paste a URL and AI extracts the property info automatically. A conversational search and map view bring retail-space matching to the next step.
common.demoDisclaimer: This site is an OSS reference implementation demo and is not intended for production use.

home.heroHeadline: Paste a URL — AI extracts the property info automatically.
home.heroLead: A reference implementation that combines conversational filtering, a map view, and tidy data management for retail-space matching.

extraction.title: URL extraction
extraction.body: AI reads listings straight from a URL

chat.title: Chat search
chat.body: Narrow down by talking to the assistant

ingest.title: URL → Auto-fill
ingest.body: Submit a listing URL and AI reads address, rent, area and saves it as a Sanity draft.

chat.title: Conversational filtering
chat.body: Generate GROQ queries from natural-language criteria like "a 30-tsubo cafe in Shinjuku".

stack.title: OSS reference
stack.body: An implementation showcase of Next.js 15 / Sanity v3 / Claude API / Tailwind v4 / Playwright.

insights.title: Property data insights
insights.lead: Aggregates the mock retail-property dataset along four axes (building type, prefecture, rent, condition) as a reference example of how to present structured data in this OSS implementation.
insights.dataSource: Data source: mock (5 records); switches to real GROQ when Sanity is connected.
